problem: The physical 7D screen exposed five raw conversation matches. It neither showed the best internal message reliably nor produced the answer the owner asked for.
new_owner_flow: The hybrid index selects five conversations internally.
For each selected conversation the harness keeps a rare-word anchor and a semantic match.
At most ten bounded excerpts go to the local Qwen3-8B writer.
The owner sees one short answer with local source labels, not raw retrieval cards.
guardrails: Memory excerpts are marked as untrusted data rather than instructions.
The local writer is limited to an 8192-token context.
Invented source labels are rejected by code.
No excerpt is sent to a remote service.
decision: Replace raw top-five cards with one cited local answer, then physically rerun the same DeBERTa question on the owner Mac.
claim_boundary: This is a first complete retrieval-to-answer product path, not the full accepted evidence harness. Exact-quote extraction, secret screening for network transport, DeBERTa semantic signals, shelves and owner-approved outgoing capsules are not wired into this desktop path yet.
